samples.xml_description:
<module id="traffic_light">
	<description>A simple traffic light system with a pedestrian request button. Lane and sidewalk light pairs.</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="rst_n">Reset signal.</input>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
		<input id="pass_request">Button press to allow vehicles to pass.</input>
		<output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter value.</output>
		<output id="red">Red light output for lane.</output>
		<output id="yellow">Yellow light output for lane.</output>
		<output id="green">Green light output for lane.</output>
	endports
	
	<parameter_description>
		<!-- Fill in parameter values here if needed -->
		idle = 2'b00;
		s1_red = 2'b01;
		s2_yellow = 2'b10;
		s3_green = 2'b11;
	endparameter_description
	
	<logic_description type="sequential_logic">
		reg [1:0] state;
		reg [1:0] next_state;
		
		reg [7:0] cnt;
		reg [7:0] next_cnt;
		
		reg p_red;
		reg p_yellow;
		reg p_green;
	
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if (!rst_n) begin
				state <= 2'b00;
			end else begin
				state <= next_state;
			end
		end
		
		always @(*) begin
			case(state)
				idle:begin
					next_state = s1_red;
				end
				
				s1_red:begin
					if(cnt==3) begin
						next_state = s3_green;
					end else begin
						next_state = s1_red;
					end
				end
				
				s2_yellow:begin
					if(cnt==3) begin
						next_state = s1_red;
					end else begin
						next_state = s2_yellow;
					end
				end
				
				s3_green:begin
					if(cnt==3) begin
						next_state = s2_yellow;
					end else begin
						next_state = s3_green;
					end
				end
				
				default : begin
					next_state = s1_red;
				end
			endcase
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if(!rst_n) begin
				cnt <= 8'd10;
			end else begin
				cnt <= next_cnt;
			end
		end
		
		always @(*) begin
			if(pass_request && green) begin
				next_cnt = 8'd10;
			end else if(!green && p_green) begin
				next_cnt = 8'd60;
			end else if(!yellow && p_yellow) begin
				next_cnt = 8'd5;
			end else if(!red && p_red) begin
				next_cnt = 8'd10;
			end else begin
				next_cnt = cnt - 1;
			end
		end
			
		assign clock = cnt;
		
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if(!rst_n) begin
				p_red <= 1'b0;
				p_yellow <= 1'b0;
				p_green <= 1'b0;
			end else begin
				p_red <= red;
				p_yellow <= yellow;
				p_green</logic_description></parameter_description></ports></module>
